_comment: Daily caps. Tracked in ledger/usage.jsonl. Trawlers hard-stop when their cap is hit; processing plant warns and asks Harbor Master to confirm before continuing past cap.

youtube_trawler._note: Title-based filtering in find-new-kiriakou-videos.mjs is rule-based, not LLM. No fleet calls happen at sea for YouTube — pure cost savings.

web_trawler._note: Web results need LLM triage because titles are messier. worker_fast (Groq Llama 3.3) only.

filleting._note: One long-context call per video to segment transcript into topic-coherent passages.

deboning._note: One reasoning call per segment to extract claims with verbatim quotes + timestamps.

canning._note: Drafts the article diff against existing markdown. Few-shot prompted from sample KiriPedia articles.

tripwires._note: Harbor Master must surface warning to user; hard stop pauses plant until user confirms.

escalation_to_opus._note: These ALWAYS bypass auto-merge and surface to Opus (you, in a separate chat). Token-cheap because volume is tiny.
triggers: Claim that touches doctrine rule #3 edge cases (see [[feedback_kiripedia_doctrine]] and [[feedback_kiripedia_voice_calibration]])
Claim about Chabad as victim (see [[project_chabad_tracker_doctrine]] — these must be excluded from the DB)
Source from a channel NOT on grounds.youtube.trusted_channels — needs Opus pass on whether to add the channel
